newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala April consumer prices drop 0.06 percent.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala April consumer prices drop 0.06 percent.

text.p: Guatemalan consumer prices dropped 0.06 percent in April, compared to a rise of 1.18 percent in the same month last year, the National Statistics Institute said on Wednesday.
March consumer prices rose 0.04 percent this year.
In the first four months, inflation was 3.40 percent compared with 4.08 percent a year ago, the institute said.
Year-over-year inflation was 10.13 percent on April 30, down from 11.51 percent as of March 31. Year-over-year inflation at the end of April 1996 was 11.95 percent.
